title: Energy cooperative
name: Sunvale
ask: Create a brand identity for Sunvale, the community energy cooperative in this folder.
owner: Owner preferences: optimistic, local and trustworthy, not corporate-green; for neighbours who co-own solar roofs. No suns with rays, leaves, lightning bolts, houses or plugs. Web, a members' app icon (iOS, Android), social, and print for flyers.
